name: EnergyEfficiencyRebateProcessor
tagline: Rebate applications, verification, inspections and payments for utility efficiency programmes – in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete back-office app for energy-efficiency rebate programmes: deemed-savings rebate calculator with cost and per-application caps, eight eligibility checks, document and duplicate checks, threshold and sample inspections on a week calendar, approvals against residential and commercial budgets, and payment batches. Works with a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL in canvas apps, a subgrid in model-driven apps and the Power Pages Web API.
features: Deemed-savings measure library with incentive overrides
Rebate = qty × incentive, capped by % of project cost and sector cap
Submission window, trade-ally, duplicate and document checks
Inspection threshold + random QA sample, Pass/Partial/Fail
Budget control per sector with open-pipeline view
Allowed status transitions, bulk actions and undo
controlType: standard (2 controls: EnergyEfficiencyRebateProcessor data-set + EnergyEfficiencyRebateProcessorPortal field control)
